properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.outbox.poll-delay-ms
properties.description: How often the relay looks for unsent rows, after the first poll. @Scheduled(fixedDelay) runs first and waits afterwards, so raising this does not prevent a poll at startup — that is what relay.enabled=false is for. Lower means lower latency and more empty queries.

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.outbox.relay.enabled
properties.description: Whether the relay is scheduled. false removes only the schedule, not the relay: nothing polls on its own, and a caller can drive OutboxRelay.relay() directly.

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.outbox.cleanup.enabled
properties.description: Deletes sent rows past retention. Off by default — an unbounded table is visible, whereas deleting rows someone still wanted is not. Nothing else under cleanup takes effect until it is on.

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.outbox.cleanup.lock-name
properties.description: ShedLock name for the cleanup schedule, so one instance at a time purges. Defaults to '${spring.application.name}-outbox-cleanup'.

properties.name: aipersimmon.ddd.outbox.cleanup.lock-at-most-for
properties.description: ShedLock upper bound on how long a cleanup run may hold its lock.
